clues.text: Aaron wore it with two onyx stones on its shoulder pieces, engraved with the names of Israel's sons.
Gideon made one from gold earrings taken as plunder, and all Israel worshiped it in Ophrah.
While still a boy, Samuel ministered before the LORD dressed in a linen one.
King David wore a linen one as he danced with all his might before the LORD while the ark was brought up.
The priest Ahimelech told David that Goliath's sword lay wrapped in a cloth behind it.
When David learned Saul was plotting against him at Keilah, he told Abiathar the priest to bring it.
The Danites carried it off from Micah's house, along with his household idols and graven image.

taken: Fleeing from Saul, David took this Philistine's sword from the priest Ahimelech, wrapped in cloth behind the ephod.
